correctness.rationale: Reconstructed weighted l1 enumeration F(z)=(1-z)^-1 product_i (1+z^a_i)/(1-z^a_i) directly from signed-coordinate generating functions. At primitive mth roots denominator zeros count m|a_i and numerator zeros count (m even,a_i=m/2 mod m); exact uncancelled pole orders imply the minimum Ehrhart quasiperiod, both directions, not just a divisor. Odd factors force noncollapse; dyadic powers give inequalities c_(j-1)>=sum_(k>=j)c_k. Their tail-count iteration yields d>=2^r and unique equality multiplicities; resulting (1+z^d)/(1-z)^(d+1) violates lattice-polytope h*-degree-one/interior-point counts in dimension d. Applies all d>=1 and positive integer a_i; rigidity only max weight>1. Independent exact counts, criterion and polynomial comparison on 209 weight multisets; finite tests not proof.
